import Mathlib.FieldTheory.Separable
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Finiteness.Basic

/-!
# Finite separable extensions and the image of a field map

An algebra map from a field identifies its domain with its image intermediate
field. Finiteness and separability of the ambient extension therefore transfer
from that image to the original domain, with its given algebra structure.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

variable {k K L : Type*} [Field k] [Field K] [Field L]
  [Algebra k K] [Algebra k L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower k K L]

/-- The algebra map identifies its domain with an intermediate field known to
be its image. Its forward map is the given algebra map with restricted codomain. -/
def fieldImageAlgEquiv (F : IntermediateField k L)
    (hF : Set.range (algebraMap K L) = (F : Set L)) : K ≃ₐ[k] F := by
  let f : K →ₐ[k] F := (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k K L).codRestrict F.toSubalgebra
    (fun x => by
      change algebraMap K L x ∈ (F : Set L)
      rw [← hF]
      exact ⟨x, rfl⟩)
  apply AlgEquiv.ofBijective f
  constructor
  · exact f.injective
  · intro y
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (show (y : L) ∈ Set.range (algebraMap K L) by
      rw [hF]; exact y.property)
    exact ⟨x, Subtype.ext hx⟩

@[simp]
theorem fieldImageAlgEquiv_coe (F : IntermediateField k L)
    (hF : Set.range (algebraMap K L) = (F : Set L)) (x : K) :
    (fieldImageAlgEquiv F hF x : L) = algebraMap K L x := rfl

/-- Finite separability over an image intermediate field is finite separability
over the original field via its given algebra map. -/
theorem finite_isSeparable_of_fieldImage (F : IntermediateField k L)
    (hF : Set.range (algebraMap K L) = (F : Set L))
    [Algebra.IsSeparable F L] [Module.Finite F L] :
    Module.Finite K L ∧ Algebra.IsSeparable K L := by
  let e : K ≃ₐ[k] F := fieldImageAlgEquiv F hF
  have he : (algebraMap K L).comp e.symm.toRingEquiv.toRingHom =
      (RingEquiv.refl L).toRingHom.comp (algebraMap F L) := by
    ext x
    change algebraMap K L (e.symm x) = (x : L)
    rw [← fieldImageAlgEquiv_coe F hF]
    exact congrArg (fun z : F => (z : L)) (e.apply_symm_apply x)
  exact ⟨Module.Finite.of_equiv_equiv e.symm.toRingEquiv (RingEquiv.refl L) he,
    Algebra.IsSeparable.of_equiv_equiv e.symm.toRingEquiv (RingEquiv.refl L) he⟩

end
end Hartshorne
